title: Domain Concept Vocabulary
description: Pins the domain_concept_vocabulary.json artifact emitted by Stage 3 (large-LLM concept extraction, plans/textbook-llm-synthesis-3stage-2026-05.md §4.3). Written as a sibling of concept_graph_semantic.json at LibV2/courses/<slug>/concept_graph/domain_concept_vocabulary.json. It is the merged, de-duplicated (on canonical_slug) per-chapter concept list; it is compiled into (canonical, [regex]) seed pairs that re-tag SemantiK chunks before the co-occurrence graph build. Also the surface a future CURIE-minting pass reads.

course_slug.description: Slug form of the course identifier (canonical_slug).

provider.description: Runtime-resolved provider name. When all per-chapter calls degraded to the empty-seed fallback (§5.4), this records the degraded provenance.

chapter_call_count.description: Number of per-chapter LLM calls dispatched in this Stage-3 run.

chapter_synthesis_failures.description: Chapter IDs whose per-chapter concept call exhausted its parse-retry budget (§5.4 failure isolation). Informational — surfaced by DomainConceptVocabularyValidator at warning severity, not a hard fail.

concept_count.description: Asserted concept count. Must equal len(concepts) — DomainConceptVocabularyValidator emits VOCAB_COUNT_MISMATCH otherwise.

canonical.description: Canonical concept name, run through lib/ontology/slugs.py::canonical_slug at emit.

aliases.description: Surface-form aliases. Maps directly onto compile_domain_concept_seeds's {id, aliases} input.

chapter_ids.description: IDs of the chapters this concept was extracted from.

definition_hint.description: Short gloss of the concept for downstream consumers.
